correctness.rationale: In F2[u]/(u^6+u+1), irreducibility, normalized projective points (4161), smooth cubic membership (81), and canonical cross-product lines were reconstructed. All 3240 unordered curve-point pairs give 1056 distinct 3-secants and 72 distinct 2-secants. Independent projective incidence enumerates all 4080 exterior N(P) and reconstructs the entire six-bin histogram and the exact twelve-point F4 identity, not just its total. Since a degree-three line section has three distinct rational points iff the corresponding projection fiber splits completely, the incidence certificate proves the entire finite claim. Double count sum N(P)=1056*62=65472. No higher-field conclusion inferred.
residual_risks: All assertions are over exactly F64 and marked plane centers; no general extension or conjugacy classification.
